# PocketLLM

> Inference library for large language models on a single consumer GPU, and for edge and mobile targets -- quantized checkpoints, no host offload

This is the index of every page the documentation site publishes. It is generated from `mkdocs.yml`
by `scripts/gen_llms_txt.py`; edit the nav, not this file, and re-run the script.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lvyufeng.github.io/PocketLLM/)
- [Getting started](https://lvyufeng.github.io/PocketLLM/getting-started/)
